title: 第2437章 身子虚第2436章 出发吧
content_zh:
谁喜不喜欢谁，谁对谁有没有意见，这些都是萧家的事情，对于李落来说，无足轻重。
他现在唯一的想法，就是赶紧去到鹤来山，把那萧易行“引荐”给陆天明。
只是。
这萧易行好像真的是吃错药了一般。
赶路的速度，远远未到达九重天的水平。
以至于一行人在快要到正午的时候才来到鹤来山脚下。
而又为了照顾这“娇滴滴”的萧大少爷，上山的过程，几人都是用双腿赶路，并没有说使出什么绝技或者法宝。
“萧少爷，反正已经到了鹤来山了，要不咱们歇会儿？”
快到半山腰的时候，李落见萧易行额头上虚汗直冒，便开口提议。
萧易行抬头望了一眼半山腰处的云雾。
摇头道：“那破庙就在半山腰往上一点点，去到那里再休息吧。”
反正已经来到鹤来山了，李落也就没那么着急了，点点头应了声是。
很快。
萧易行口中的那个破庙，终于出现在了视野中。
一行人进入的时候，已经有不少上山打柴或者打猎的乡亲在里面歇息了。
由于萧易行等人穿着比较奢华。
进入的时候，里面休息的老乡们，情不自禁就投来了诧异的目光。
他们不见得认识萧易行或者萧菲姚，但绝对看得出来这刚进来的几人，一定是出自大户人家。
所以，众人下意识便往边上移，将破庙内最中间的位置空了出来。
萧易行见状，朝身边的赵丰努了努嘴：“多少赏点。”

主仆之间显然没少干过这种事。
满脸痘子的赵丰点点头，伸手入怀抓了一大把碎银出来。
随即挨个分发给那些个老乡们。
有眼力见的，得了赏钱后连连道谢，随即快速离开了寺庙。
也有稍微愚钝的，出了寺庙后没有选择离开，而是坐在了外面的院子里继续休息。
短暂的时间过后，寺庙内就只剩下了萧易行一行五人，以及，一樽断了香火的掉皮菩萨。
“黄杏，先做点吃食，吃饱喝足，再做事。”
刚一坐下，萧易行便吩咐起来。
歪嘴的女人点点头，从乾坤宝物中掏出锅碗瓢盆以及食材，走到一边忙活了起来。
李落撇了撇嘴，小声嘀咕道：“搞了半天，不也是个伙夫吗，刚才在老朽面前装什么装？”
“前辈，你说什么？”旁边萧菲姚奇怪道。
李落讪讪一笑：“我刚才说，那黄杏一看长相就是个会做饭的主儿，肯定能干得不行。”
萧菲姚虽然长相算不得顶尖，但与黄杏一对比，可以说一个天一个地。
她眨了眨那双漂亮的眸子，须臾后轻声道：“前辈，你是变相在说黄杏长得丑吗？”
李落闻言瞪大了眼睛，不可思议的望着萧菲姚。
还没来得及反驳呢。
萧菲姚便微笑道：“我还没有进入萧家的时候，周边的老人们要夸一个长得丑的人，一般都说人家老实能干呢！”
“咳咳咳...”
李落被自己的口水呛到，忍不住咳嗽起来。
那边萧易行侧目望来：“前辈，可是身子有什么不舒服？”
content_en:
Who likes whom or not, who has objections to whom, these are all matters of the Xiao family and are of no importance to Li Luo.
His only thought now was to quickly go to Helai Mountain and "introduce" Xiao Yixing to Lu Tianming.
only.
It seems that Xiao Yixing really took the wrong medicine.
The speed of the journey was far from the level of Jiuzhongtian.
So much so that the group of people arrived at the foot of Helai Mountain just before noon.
And in order to take care of the "dear Didi" Young Master Xiao, during the process of going up the mountain, several people hurried on their legs and did not mention any special skills or magic weapons.
"Master Xiao, we have arrived at Helai Mountain anyway, why don't we take a break?"
When they were almost halfway up the mountain, Li Luo saw Xiao Yixing sweating profusely on his forehead, so he made a suggestion.
Xiao Yixing raised his head and glanced at the clouds and mist halfway up the mountain.
He shook his head and said: "The ruined temple is just a little way up the mountainside. Let's go there and rest."
Since they had already arrived at Helai Mountain, Li Luo was not so anxious and nodded in agreement.
soon.
The ruined temple that Xiao Yixing talked about finally appeared in sight.
When the group entered, many villagers who had gone up the mountain to collect firewood or hunt were already resting inside.
Because Xiao Yixing and others were dressed more luxuriously.
When entering, the fellow villagers resting inside couldn't help but cast surprised glances.
They may not know Xiao Yixing or Xiao Feiyao, but they can definitely tell that the few people who just came in must come from wealthy families.
Therefore, everyone subconsciously moved to the side, freeing up the middle position in the ruined temple.
When Xiao Yixing saw this, he nuzzled at Zhao Feng beside him: "How many reward points."
Masters and servants obviously did this kind of thing frequently.
Zhao Feng, whose face was full of acne, nodded, reached into his arms and grabbed a large handful of broken silver.
Then they were distributed to the fellow villagers one by one.
The discerning man thanked him profusely after receiving the reward, and then quickly left the temple.
There were also some who were a little dull and did not choose to leave after leaving the temple. Instead, they sat in the courtyard outside and continued to rest.
After a short period of time, only Xiao Yixing and his party of five people were left in the temple, as well as a bottle of skinned Bodhisattva that had lost its incense.
"Huang Xing, make some food first. Eat and drink enough before doing anything."
As soon as he sat down, Xiao Yixing started to give orders.
The woman with a crooked mouth nodded, took out the pots, pans and ingredients from the Qiankun Treasures, walked to the side and started working.
Li Luo curled his lips and muttered in a low voice: "You've been doing it for a long time, aren't you a cook? What were you pretending to do in front of this old man just now?"
"Senior, what did you say?" Xiao Feiyao asked curiously.
Li Luo smiled coquettishly: "I just said that Huang Xing looks like a good cook, so he must be very capable."
Although Xiao Feiyao's appearance is not top-notch, compared with Huang Xingyi, it can be said that she is a world away.
She blinked her beautiful eyes and said softly after a moment: "Senior, are you saying that Huang Xing is ugly in disguise?"
Li Luo's eyes widened when he heard this, and he looked at Xiao Feiyao in disbelief.
I haven't had time to refute yet.
Xiao Feiyao smiled and said: "Before I entered the Xiao family, the old people around me would praise an ugly person. They usually said that they were honest and capable!"
"Cough cough cough..."
Li Luo choked on his own saliva and couldn't help coughing.
Xiao Yixing looked sideways over there: "Senior, what's wrong with you?"
